{{nihongo|'''Kanno Shrine'''|神野神社 (まんのう町)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Sanuki Province]].

'''Kanno Shrine''' (かんのじんじゃ) is a historic shrine in Kanno, {{ill|Mannō, Kagawa|ar|مانو|arz|بلده مانو|ca|Mannō|ceb|Mannō Chō|de|Mannō (Kagawa)|es|Mannō (Kagawa)|fa|مانو، کاگاوا|fr|Mannō|id|Mannō, Kagawa|it|Mannō|ja|まんのう町|ko|만노정|ms|Mannō, Kagawa|pl|Mannō|ru|Манно|sv|Mannō|tl|Manno, Kagawa|tr|Mannō|uk|Манно|ur|مانو، کاگاوا|zh|滿濃町|qid=Q1350204}}, {{ill|Nakatado District, Kagawa|ca|Districte de Naka-Tado|ceb|Nakatado-gun|de|Nakatado-gun (Kagawa)|es|Distrito de Nakatado|fr|District de Nakatado|id|Distrik Nakatado, Kagawa|it|Distretto di Nakatado|ja|仲多度郡|ko|나카타도군|pl|Powiat Nakatado|uk|Повіт Накатадо|zh|仲多度郡|qid=Q1206155}}, {{ill|Kagawa Prefecture|Q161454|qid=Q161454}}. It was enshrined as guardian deity of {{ill|Manno Lake|de|Mannō-See|ja|満濃池|ko|만노이케 저수지|zh|满浓池|qid=Q20983084}} and counted as one of the 24 Engishiki shrines of Sanuki.

The enshrined deities are said to be {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Mizuhanome no Mikoto}}, {{ill|Ame no Hohi|qid=Q10940685|lt=Ame-no-Hohi no Mikoto}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Wakeikazuchi no Mikoto}}, and {{ill|Emperor Saga|ar|الإمبراطور ساغا|azb|ساقا (ایمپیراتور)|be|Імператар Сага|bn|সম্রাট সাগা|ca|Saga Tennō|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر ساگا|cs|Saga|de|Saga (Tennō)|el|Αυτοκράτορας Σάγκα|eo|Saga (imperiestro)|es|Saga Tennō|eu|Saga enperadorea|fa|امپراتور ساگا|fr|Saga (empereur)|id|Kaisar Saga|it|Saga (imperatore del Giappone)|ja|嵯峨天皇|ko|사가 천황|nl|Saga (keizer)|pl|Saga (cesarz)|pt|Saga (imperador)|ru|Император Сага|sh|Car Saga|simple|Emperor Saga|sl|Cesar Saga|sv|Saga (kejsare)|sw|Saga wa Japani|th|จักรพรรดิซางะ|tl|Emperador Saga|tr|Saga (imparator)|uk|Імператор Саґа|vi|Thiên hoàng Saga|yo|Emperor Saga|zh|嵯峨天皇|zh_min_nan|Saga Thian-hông|qid=Q316654}}<ref>[http://kagawa.bine.jp/jinnjya/manou/53kano/kanno53.html Kanno Shrine]</ref>.
